استهديت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْدَيْتُ (istahdaytu) /is.tah.daj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اِسْتَهْدَيْتَ (istahdayta) /is.tah.daj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اِسْتَهْدَيْتِ (istahdayti) /is.tah.daj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اُسْتُهْدِيتُ (ustuhdītu) /us.tuh.diː.tu/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
